name: sel-lang
description: A small expression language for validation rules.

One rule file evaluates identically on PHP, JavaScript, C++23 and Common Lisp, held to a normative spec by a conformance suite and a differential fuzzer that runs all four and compares them byte for byte.
Exact decimal arithmetic, no floating point, no truthiness, code-point-accurate text, and a regex subset both PCRE and ECMAScript agree on.

system-srell.description: Link vcpkg's SRELL instead of the vendored copy. Must be the pinned release (2026.05); run the conformance suite before trusting it.
